cultura.name: El Flamenco
cultura.description:
Soulful Andalusian folk art combining raw singing, rhythmic guitar, and footwork.
Born of Romani, Moorish, and southern Spanish musical traditions.

cultura.name: Els Castells
cultura.description:
Human towers rising up to ten stories high in town plazas.
Built through collective strength, careful balance, and community trust.

cultura.name: La Sardana
cultura.description:
Traditional circular folk dance performed in open public squares.
Dancers hold raised hands and count complex steps to live wind bands.

cultura.name: La Jota
cultura.description:
Lively couple dance featuring quick kicks, spins, and clicking castanets.
Accompanied by strummed guitars, bandurrias, and celebratory song.
